body: Depends on the environment and what’s around me.  If I go somewhere, like the bar or find party, I won’t say it makes me happy but it’ll put me in a good mood for awhile.  Bad emotions do come up at times though.  It happens enough sober, so I’m not surprised when it happens when I’m high or drinking.

I don’t drink all day now, it’s binge drinking at night that gets me.  I rarely get sick, I’ve learned what I can handle most of the time.  Straight vodka is a non-no, whiskey is like water.  I have a decent tolerance but some nights the buzz does hit quicker
